stage0019_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Alright... all set!
　Both $$ダイ・ガード$$ and I are in top shape!」

stage0019_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$タケル$$
「So that's the new $$ダイ・ガード$$?」

stage0019_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$青山$$
「The base frame's the same, but
　we reworked every part's design
　for a big output boost.」

stage0019_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Plus we made the Great Knot Punisher
　standard, so no more swap delay.」

stage0019_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$大杉$$
「Mind you, the refit costs strained the budget,
　and PR Section 2 and related units went into the red.」

stage0019_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$赤木$$
「Don't worry, Chief!
　This $$ダイ・ガード$$ will earn it right back!」

stage0019_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$大杉$$
「Oh, no, it's embarrassing...
　He's just got spirit to spare...」

stage0019_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Heh... I'd love to learn that gutsiness.」

stage0019_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$佐伯$$
「I'll go over the plan once more.」

stage0019_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$佐伯$$
「Judging by the dimensional boundary's warp,
　a $$界震$$ will hit this area soon.」

stage0019_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$佐伯$$
「Against the $$ヘテロダイン$$ expected there,
　Crusher Team will handle it, led by $$ダイ・ガード$$.」

stage0019_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「With so many elderly, and the road
　to the village blocked by a landslide,
　evacuation just wasn't possible...」

stage0019_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's fine, Miss $$スズネ$$.
　We just need to beat the $$ヘテロダイン$$
　before it reaches the village.」

stage0019_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Just in case, everyone from PR
　Section 2 has gone to the village too,
　but let's settle this ourselves first.」

stage0019_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$横沢$$
「We'll prepare things here too, just in case.」

stage0019_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$伊集院$$
「$$赤木$$!
　Screw this up and you'll regret it!」

stage0019_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$田口$$
「Take good care of $$ダイ・ガード$$!
　If it's clearly your fault, the repair bill
　lands right back on PR Section 2!」

stage0019_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$赤木$$
「I know, I know!
　Just relax and trust me on this!」

stage0019_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$石塚$$
「Whenever someone says stuff like that,
　nothing good ever happens...」

stage0019_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$入江$$
「So, in other words, always... right?」

stage0019_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「So they're fighting too, aren't they.」

stage0019_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$大杉$$
「$$ダイ・ガード$$'s the one who beats the $$ヘテロダイン$$,
　but all of PR Section 2 is fighting too.」

stage0019_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$シンジ$$
（There are people fighting
　even without piloting robots...）

stage0019_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Judging by the observation data,
　a $$界震$$ will occur soon.」

stage0019_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$佐伯$$... this operation is your plan.
　I'm counting on you to command it.」

stage0019_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$正太郎$$
「So many $$ヘテロダイン$$s, over there!」

stage0019_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wait a second!
　Nobody told me about this!」

stage0019_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$佐伯$$
「This is unexpected, but it's likely
　caused by multiple overlapping Quakes!」

stage0019_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So several $$界震$$s hit
　at once, and the overlap in conditions
　brought out multiple $$ヘテロダイン$$s too.」

stage0019_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Isn't this because $$赤木$$ was
　whining about having nothing to do?」

stage0019_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$n
「No matter how many show up,
　we've got no choice but to do this...!」

stage0019_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$葵$$
「That's right.
　We were called in exactly
　for times like this.」

stage0019_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$赤木$$
「Right!
　We have to protect the village!」

stage0019_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$佐伯$$
「All units, spread out and intercept!
　Not one $$ヘテロダイン$$ enters the village!」

stage0019_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Roger!
　...Our first real fight in a while.」

stage0019_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Of course!
　Let's do this, $$いぶき$$, $$青山$$!」

stage0019_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$赤木$$
「Let's go!
　Even a salaryman can defend the peace!」

stage0019_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$田中司令$$
「This is bad...!
　Another $$界震$$ is coming!」

stage0019_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「Another $$ヘテロダイン$$'s shown up!」

stage0019_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$竜馬$$
「This is bad!
　It's close to the village!」

stage0019_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$佐伯$$
「$$赤木$$, this is reckless!
　Pull back from the $$ヘテロダイン$$ for now!」

stage0019_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$赤木$$
「No way!
　If I pull back, the $$ヘテロダイン$$ will
　rush straight into the village!」

stage0019_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$佐伯$$
「$$横沢$$'s team evacuated the village's
　north side! A little intrusion should be...」

stage0019_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$赤木$$
「You say 'a little', $$佐伯$$, but what
　about the people who'll lose their homes
　because of that little bit!?」

stage0019_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$赤木$$
「It's not about just rebuilding!
　If the memories of the people who lived
　there are lost, there's no getting them back!」

stage0019_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$佐伯$$
「I understand what you're saying, but
　the other members can't go help either!」

stage0019_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$赤木$$
「Making that work somehow
　is $$ダイ・ガード$$'s and our job!」

stage0019_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$いぶき$$
「It's fine, $$佐伯$$!
　$$ダイ・ガード$$ can still hold out!」

stage0019_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$青山$$
「Just beat the other $$ヘテロダイン$$s
　and come lend us a hand meanwhile!」

stage0019_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Don't let your guard down!
　The $$ヘテロダイン$$ will push us over!」

stage0019_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$青山$$
「I'll stabilize the output somehow!
　You focus on holding it back!」

stage0019_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「What do you intend to do, $$佐伯$$?」

stage0019_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$佐伯$$
「...I'm betting on $$赤木$$ holding out to the very end.」

stage0019_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$佐伯$$
「I know it's inefficient!
　But still...!」

stage0019_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$大杉$$
「I know.
　You feel the same way he does, huh.」

stage0019_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ミサト$$
「One more person's been inspired by $$赤木$$, you know.」

stage0019_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$佐伯$$
「Lt. Col. Katsuragi!
　Are you in the hangar!?」

stage0019_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I'm launching Unit-01.
　Please open the hatch.」

stage0019_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I don't know.
　But this is Unit-01's pilot's own will.」

stage0019_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$赤木$$!
　Please get out of the way!」

stage0019_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$n
「The EVA's A.T. Field
　blew the $$ヘテロダイン$$ away!」

stage0019_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$赤木$$
「You saved us, $$シンジ$$.
　Did $$佐伯$$ tell you to sortie?」

stage0019_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I thought... maybe there's something even I can do...」

stage0019_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$青山$$
「No time to get emotional.
　The $$ヘテロダイン$$'s coming.」

stage0019_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$シンジ$$, we're fighting as a duo!
　Back me up!」

stage0019_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$葵$$
「Feels like a hot-blooded coach and a shy student.」

stage0019_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$竜馬$$
「He's a kid who cares what others think.
　There's plenty I can learn from him.」

stage0019_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$赤木$$
「Let's go, $$シンジ$$!
　We'll protect the village with our strength!」

stage0019_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Look who's talking.
　We'd have been in trouble if $$シンジ$$ hadn't come.」

stage0019_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$青山$$
「Yeah.
　Today's MVP has to be $$シンジ$$.」

stage0019_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Yeah, yeah.
　After all, our greatest weapon
　really is everyone's teamwork.」

stage0019_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$赤木$$
「Of course, $$シンジ$$'s part of our team too.」

stage0019_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$いぶき$$
「A $$ヘテロダイン$$'s in the village!」

stage0019_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$赤木$$
「Damn it!
　This makes $$ダイ・ガード$$ pointless!」

stage0019_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$甲児$$
「No matter how many come, I won't lose!
　Bring it on!」

stage0019_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'll do my part too, $$赤木$$!
　Even a high schooler can protect peace!」

stage0019_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't lose, $$鉄人$$!
　We're protecting this village, no matter what!」

stage0019_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Here we come, $$ヘテロダイン$$!
　Even an elementary schooler can protect peace!」

stage0019_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Everyone at $$２１世紀警備保障$$ is trying hard too!
　Takeo General Company won't be outdone!」

stage0019_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Let's do this!
　Even a company president can protect peace!」

stage0019_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If it's a monster with no pilot, no will,
　then I'll crush it without hesitation!」

stage0019_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Here I come, $$ヘテロダイン$$!
　Even a guy like me can protect peace!」

stage0019_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$葵$$
「Same as always, but $$２１世紀警備保障$$
　always gets us fired up.」

stage0019_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$くらら$$
「We can't be outdone either, $$葵$$!」

stage0019_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$葵$$
「OK!
　Team D can protect peace too, you know!」

stage0019_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n...
　You seem more focused than usual...」

stage0019_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$スズネ$$
（$$赤木$$'s words changed $n...
　Could it be, the person $$竜馬$$ was talking about...）

stage0019_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$n
「Here I go, Miss $$スズネ$$!
　A student and teacher can protect peace too!」

stage0019_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$シンジ$$
（It's not because Father told me to...
　If there's something even I can do...）

stage0019_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I'll do it too...!
　I can protect something too!）

stage0019_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$赤木$$
「I'll show the $$ヘテロダイン$$
　the power of the reborn $$ダイ・ガード$$!」

stage0019_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Don't get so fired up that you take
　unnecessary damage, okay?」

stage0019_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$青山$$
「$$いぶき$$'s right.
　If you wreck the new one, $$墨田$$, Rika,
　and all of PR Section 2 will be in tears.」

stage0019_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$赤木$$
「Still better than making the citizens cry!」

stage0019_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$いぶき$$
「Ah, geez... same old $$赤木$$, as always.」

stage0019_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$青山$$
「Can't help it.
　Since it's come to this, let's try our best
　to rein in $$赤木$$'s recklessness, even a little.」

stage0019_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$赤木$$
「In short, that's what we call teamwork!」

stage0019_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$赤木$$
「Th, that's... denying $$ダイ・ガード$$'s
　greatest weapon, of all things...!」

stage0019_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$青山$$
「That's enough chatting!
　The $$ヘテロダイン$$'s here, $$赤木$$!」

stage0019_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$赤木$$
「This is it, $$ヘテロダイン$$!
　Even a salaryman can protect peace!」

stage0019_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$タケル$$
「The village people are behind us!
　We can't let the $$ヘテロダイン$$ through, no matter what!」

stage0019_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$タケル$$
「Let's do this, $$ゴッドマーズ$$!
　The Crusher Team protects peace!」
